title: Preservation of the indicated side under a move
statement: Let $p$ be an integer, $b$ a Boolean, and $d\in\{-1,0,1\}$. If $p$ lies on the side of the origin indicated by $b$, then after replacing $p$ by $p+d$, it lies on the side indicated by the updated tag: the tag becomes true exactly when $p=0$ and $d$ is not $-1$, and otherwise remains $b$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ lies on the side indicated by $b$
